section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the data analysis procedures used in the study. Pearson correlations were performed to examine associations between age, BMI, early memories of warmth and safeness (EMWSS), social safeness (SSPS), body appreciation (BAS-2), and eating psychopathology (EDE-Q). Path analyses were conducted to test a mediation model where social safeness and body appreciation mediate the relationship between early memories of warmth/safeness and disordered eating behaviors, using Maximum Likelihood estimation and Bootstrap resampling with 5000 samples.
